exhibition.title: Visiting Specimen
exhibition.blurb: On loan from {lab}. No stakes, no paperwork, no witnesses.
exhibition.blurbAnonymous: Somebody left this on the doorstep. No stakes, no paperwork, no witnesses.
exhibition.koLine: {name} bows, collects its things, and is escorted politely to the gate.
exhibition.accepted: {name} is signed in at the gate and shown to the visitors' pen.

refusals.notAFile: That is not a card. Paste the SVG, or type the specimen code.
refusals.noSpecimen: No specimen in that file. A card carries its genome in its metadata.
refusals.noCode: That is not a specimen code. It should start with a frame letter.
refusals.noAnatomy: That code has a frame but no anatomy, so there is nothing to build.
refusals.badChunk: "{chunk}" is not a socket. Each piece reads socket.part.grade.
refusals.nothing: There is no specimen in that.
refusals.badFrame: This card is built on a frame this lab does not have: "{frame}".
refusals.emptyTokens: This card has a frame but no anatomy on it.
refusals.badPart: This card names a part nobody has: "{partId}", in the {socket} socket.
refusals.badGrade: "{grade}" is not a grade this lab recognises.
